questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Before joining the online lecture, a student asked the teacher ______.
options: where could she find the reading list
where she could find the reading list
where she can found the reading list
where did she find the reading list
questions.solution: asked 后接宾语从句，从句应用陈述语序“疑问词+主语+谓语”；主句为过去时，could也符合时态呼应，故选B。
questions.title: 线上讲座语境·宾语从句语序

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The survey does not tell us ______; it only shows how many people borrowed bicycles.
questions.solution: tell us后为宾语从句，why后使用陈述语序“they chose”；A和D使用疑问句倒装，C结构错误。
questions.title: 共享单车调查·宾语从句语序

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: When checking the experiment record, the judge wanted to know ______ after the temperature had risen.
options: what the team did measure it
questions.solution: know后接宾语从句；what作measured的宾语，从句保持“the team measured”的陈述语序，故选A。
questions.title: 实验记录复核·宾语从句语序

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Although the map records average noise levels, it cannot explain ______ at the same hour.
options: why is one street much quieter than another
why one street is much quieter than another
why one street much quieter is than another
why does one street be much quieter than another
questions.solution: explain后为宾语从句，即使含比较结构也应保持陈述语序“one street is...”，只有B正确。
questions.title: 城市噪声地图·复杂宾语从句语序

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Either the student guides or the museum manager ______ responsible for opening the exhibition hall each morning.
questions.solution: either...or连接并列主语时，谓语与较近的主语一致；manager为单数，且描述日常职责，故用is。
questions.title: 展厅开放安排·就近一致

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Neither the damaged labels nor the digital record ______ enough information to identify the old photograph.
questions.solution: neither...nor采用就近一致，靠近谓语的digital record为单数；句子陈述当前事实，应用provides。
questions.title: 旧照片鉴定·就近一致

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Not only the coach but also the young athletes ______ willing to test the new training schedule for a month.
questions.solution: not only...but also连接主语时遵循就近原则，临近的athletes为复数；语境为当前意愿，故选are。
questions.title: 训练计划试行·就近一致

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: There ______ to be neither a simple explanation nor reliable evidence that the sudden decline was caused by weather alone.
questions.solution: there be类结构中，后置并列主语由neither...nor连接，谓语与邻近的a simple explanation一致，用单数appears；to be后的并列结构不改变该判断。
questions.title: 种群下降解释·复杂就近一致

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The first soil test suggested that the school garden needed more water. The students, ______, noticed that the sample had been taken just after several dry days and decided to test again before changing the watering plan.
questions.solution: 前句给出初步结论，后句却说明学生发现样本局限并决定复测，语义构成转折，however最恰当。
questions.title: 校园土壤检测·转折副词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: Nora could have copied the expert's repair instructions word for word. ______, she rewrote them as short questions so that beginners would learn to diagnose problems themselves.
questions.solution: Nora没有照抄说明，而是改写成问题，前后是取舍替代关系，句首应用Instead。
questions.title: 维修指南改写·替代副词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The app made bus arrival times easier to check. ______, access did not improve equally: passengers without smartphones still depended on the old printed schedule.
questions.solution: 前句肯定应用带来的便利，后句指出便利并未平等惠及所有人，是让步转折关系，Nevertheless最准确。
questions.title: 公交信息应用·让步转折副词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: The lights are off and the gate is locked, so the research station ______ be open to visitors at this hour.
questions.solution: 灯已关闭且大门上锁，据此可对“此刻开放”作有把握的否定推断，应用cannot。
questions.title: 研究站开放判断·情态动词

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: When the rain began, volunteers ______ young trees along the riverbank.
questions.solution: began表示过去某一时刻发生的短暂动作，当时“种树”正在进行，应用过去进行时were planting。
questions.title: 河岸植树·过去进行时

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: ______ notes immediately after each interview helps the research team distinguish observation from later memory.
questions.solution: 句子缺少主语，表示一般性的行为应用动名词短语Recording notes...作主语，谓语helps为单数。
questions.title: 访谈记录规范·动名词作主语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: To reduce bias, every application ______ by two reviewers who work independently.
questions.solution: application与check为被动关系，句子说明常规流程，用一般现在时被动语态is checked。
questions.title: 申请材料复核·一般现在时被动
